candidate_tasks.title: Strict question / option schema with validation
implementation_steps: Define Question struct {Text, Header string; MultiSelect bool; Options []Option}.
Define Option struct {Label, Description string; Preview *string}.
Validate counts (1-4 questions, 2-4 options); reject 'Other' label; require '?' suffix; cap header at 12 chars.
candidate_tasks.notes: TS schema requires 1-4 questions; each question has 2-4 options; question text must end with '?'; option labels are 1-5 words concise; header chip max 12 chars; multiSelect bool; questions cannot have an 'Other' option (UI auto-adds it).

candidate_tasks.title: Preview rendering rules (single-select only)
implementation_steps: Validate preview length under reasonable cap (e.g. 4000 chars).
Tag question with HasPreview bool for UI hint.
candidate_tasks.notes: TS allows preview content as monospace markdown box. When ANY option in a question has preview, UI switches to side-by-side; multi-select questions cannot use previews.

candidate_tasks.title: Auto-injected 'Other' option semantics
implementation_steps: When parsing user reply, recognise sentinel 'Other:<text>' or annotation block.
acceptance: Selection not lost when both used
candidate_tasks.notes: TS auto-adds 'Other' so the user can supply free-text. Tool must accept that response and surface it under 'Other' answer key.

candidate_tasks.title: Transport: post questions and await answers
implementation_steps: Parse reply into AskUserQuestionResult {Answers, Annotations, Metadata}.
candidate_tasks.notes: TS posts questions through SendMessage envelope and awaits user reply with request_id correlation.

candidate_tasks.title: Plan-mode auxiliary support
implementation_steps: Detect approval-style questions heuristically (regex on text and options).
Emit warning instructing tool to use ExitPlanMode instead.
candidate_tasks.notes: TS notes that AskUserQuestion in plan mode must not be used to ask 'Should I proceed?' (use ExitPlanMode). Surface guard rail.

candidate_tasks.title: Annotations payload (preview notes)
implementation_steps: Define AnnotationEntry struct {Notes string; Preview string}.
candidate_tasks.notes: TS supports per-question annotations (notes, selected preview content) returned alongside answers.

candidate_tasks.title: Conformance tests
implementation_steps: Add gosrc/tools/ask_user_question_conformance_test.go covering schema, preview rules, multi-select, Other parsing.

candidate_tasks.title: Mirror AskUserQuestion typed result and updatedInput lifecycle
implementation_steps: Return TS-shaped typed answers/annotations data instead of JSON text only, and preserve the permission/updatedInput lifecycle when user answers are collected.
acceptance: Result data is typed and model-visible text remains TS-compatible.
updatedInput/answer lifecycle can be consumed by the runtime rather than reparsing JSON text.
